description: Every pardner CLI command (open, client open, client stop, status) prints Node's `ExperimentalWarning: SQLite is an experimental feature and might change at any time` and `(Use node --trace-warnings ...)` on stderr. The same lines are appended to client.log on every service start.
expected: First-run output contains only Pardner's own JSON result.
actual: Two lines of Node internals precede the JSON result on every invocation; a first-time user may read it as a problem.
suggested_fix: Suppress the specific experimental warning (process.removeAllListeners('warning') filter, or --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning in the bin shebang/spawn args).
